class.name: SplineTweenTrack
class.brief_description: SplineTweenTrack (`GeometryResource`) Single spline-driven tween track (BlendShape, Property Lerp, Shader Uniform, 3D Offset, or Color Gradient).
class.description: SplineTweenTrack (`GeometryResource`) Single spline-driven tween track (BlendShape, Property Lerp, Shader Uniform, 3D Offset, or Color Gradient). Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).
